notes:
REF-BM-02: metadataParser/fetcher collect only title and description; no favicon or preview image (og:image). REF-BM-06: duplicate url is detected (409 DUPLICATE_BOOKMARK with existingBookmarkId) but the editor only offers 'Save another copy'; it does not guide the user to edit the existing bookmark. REF-BM-07: BookmarkCard shows title, description, tags, domain, date but no favicon. REF-BM-10: TagInput is a plain input with no autocomplete/datalist of existing tags. REF-BM-14: search is plain LIKE; no '#tag' syntax parsing. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesised-group parsing. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread/read-later flag or view; only an unrelated 'favorite' flag exists. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions in UI or API. REF-BM-23: notes are stored and displayed as plain text (

), never rendered as markdown. REF-BM-24/25: no local HTML snapshot or PDF handling, no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archive flag/state; only permanent delete exists. REF-BM-29: no bundle/saved-filter entity. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import or export. REF-BM-32: no user settings entity, persistence, or UI (default sort, displayed items, font size).
